If you are planning a yard in Almaty in: If you are planning a trip to Almaty in winter, you should know that Almaty winters are long, cold and snowy. Snow begins to fall at the end of October and may continue until March. November usually sees light rain with temperatures as low as -5, but the cold intensifies with the arrival of December and January, reaching -3, and January is considered the coldest month of the year. Some winter visitors to Almaty prefer February, while others prefer December or early January for the Christmas holidays and New Year celebrations.
